host.title: IP address of the Shelly
host.description: Give the Shelly a fixed address in your router, so this keeps working.

pulseSeconds.title: Relay switches off again after (seconds)
pulseSeconds.description: How long the relay stays on. A switch in Home goes back to off at the same moment. 0 leaves a switch on until you turn it off.

autoCloseSeconds.title: Door closes by itself after (seconds)
autoCloseSeconds.description: For a gate or door that closes on its own. Home shows it closed again this long after you open it, and closing it in Home does not press the relay. 0 means the door stays open until you close it, which presses the relay again.

doorTravelSeconds.title: Time the door takes to open or close (seconds)

channel.title: Relay number
channel.description: 0 for a Shelly with one relay. On a Shelly with several, the first relay is 0.

password.title: Password
password.description: Only if you set a password on the Shelly itself.

pollSeconds.title: Check the relay every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: Keeps a switch in step with the wall input and the Shelly app. 0 turns the check off.
